description: An Apache Arrow Flight SQL gateway for relational databases: clients speak Flight SQL, the gateway runs their queries through ODBC or an ADO.NET provider and streams the results back compressed. Runs as a Windows service, or on Linux as a systemd service (the Linux zip needs the .NET 10 runtime (ASP.NET Core) and carries no 32-bit ODBC worker).
notes: Settings live in %ProgramData%\DbDataKit\gateway\config (server.yaml, gateway/, connections/). The state database is a SQLite file in the data directory (the 'service' topology, no setup); for a group or install database see: dbdatagateway state init. Registering the Windows service needs an elevated prompt: dbdatagateway service install. On Linux the data directory is /var/lib/dbdatakit/gateway; print a systemd unit with: dbdatagateway service unit --exec <path to dbdatagateway>
